title: Thank you
intro: Your order is in. A confirmation is on its way to the email address you gave at checkout — check the spam folder if it hasn't arrived within a few minutes.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.body:
Everything is printed once you order it. Yours goes into production within [2–5] business days.

As soon as it leaves the printer you get a second email with a tracking number.

sections.heading: Delivery
sections.body: Once dispatched, expect [3–7] business days within the region and [7–20] worldwide. The Shipping & Returns page has the full breakdown.

sections.heading: Something wrong?
sections.body: Wrong size, wrong address, or you'd like to change something — write to [hello@49unbeaten.com] as soon as you can, quoting your order number. Once a piece is in production we can no longer change it.
